@nkl.function
async def trial(right: bool, congruent: bool) -> Trial:
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(fixation(INK)))
    await nkl.sleep(600.0)
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(row(right, congruent)))
    shown = await nkl.time()
    keys = await nkl.next(
        nkl.filter(arrow_key, nkl.keys.stream())
    )
    pressed = await nkl.time()
    correct = ("right arrow" in keys.keys) == right
    if not correct:
        await nkl.show(
            nkl.constant(
                Layer(
                    graphics=[
                        row(right, congruent),
                        words(
                            "Wrong way",
                            -110.0,
                            22.0,
                            WRONG,
                        ),
                    ]
                )
            )
        )
        await nkl.sleep(500.0)
    return Trial(
        congruent=congruent,
        right=right,
        milliseconds=pressed - shown,
        correct=correct,
    )

@nkl.function
async def trial(
    number: int, coherence: float, heading: int
) -> MotionTrial:
    seed = nkl.hash(number, seed=1992)
    # The fixation mark holds for 600 to 1000 ms, so the onset can't be anticipated.
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            Layer(graphics=[background(), point(POINT)])
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(
        600.0 + float(nkl.hash(number, seed=seed) % 400)
    )
    field = Fill(
        geometry=Ellipse(
            x=0.0,
            y=0.0,
            width=APERTURE,
            height=APERTURE,
        ),
        paint=dots(
            coherence, float(heading), seed, 0.0
        ),
    )
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            Layer(graphics=[background(), field])
        )
    )
    shown = await nkl.time()
    choice = await nkl.race(respond(), expire())
    ended = await nkl.time()
    direction = "left" if heading < 0 else "right"
    # The dots go on from where they were and fade out over 200 ms, and the mark returns, swelling for a moment if the
    # answer matched the drift and fading toward the field if not.
    graphics: list[Graphic] = [
        background(),
        Opacity(
            Fill(
                geometry=field.geometry,
                paint=dots(
                    coherence,
                    float(heading),
                    seed,
                    ended - shown,
                ),
            ),
            piecewise(
                [(0, 1.0), (200, 0.0)],
                between="smoothstep",
            ),
        ),
    ]
    if choice == "none":
        graphics.append(point(POINT))
    elif choice == direction:
        grow = piecewise(
            [
                (0, 1.0),
                (120, GROWN),
                (FEEDBACK - 180, GROWN),
                (FEEDBACK, 1.0),
            ],
            between="smoothstep",
        )
        graphics.append(Scale(point(POINT), grow, grow))
    else:
        graphics.append(
            Opacity(
                point(POINT),
                piecewise(
                    [
                        (0, 1.0),
                        (120, 0.3),
                        (FEEDBACK - 180, 0.3),
                        (FEEDBACK, 1.0),
                    ],
                    between="smoothstep",
                ),
            )
        )
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(Layer(graphics=graphics))
    )
    await nkl.sleep(900.0)
    return MotionTrial(
        coherence=coherence,
        direction=direction,
        choice=choice,
        milliseconds=ended - shown,
    )

@nkl.function
async def block(number: int) -> list[Click]:
    """One ring: a starting click, then 13 selections in the ISO order."""
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(opening(number)))
    pointer = await nkl.read(nkl.pointer.signal())
    down = pointer.down
    last = pointer.location
    moved = await nkl.time()
    moving = False
    clicks: list[Click] = []
    selection = 0
    while selection <= COUNT:
        pointer = await nkl.next(nkl.pointer.stream())
        now = await nkl.time()
        at = pointer.location
        if (
            not moving
            and math.hypot(at.x - last.x, at.y - last.y)
            > STILL
        ):
            moving = True
            moved = now
        if pointer.down and not down:
            target = ORDER[selection]
            clicks.append(
                Click(
                    block=number,
                    selection=selection,
                    target=target,
                    x=at.x,
                    y=at.y,
                    hit=hits(number, target, at),
                    moved=moved if moving else now,
                    milliseconds=now,
                )
            )
            await nkl.show(
                nkl.constant(
                    selected(number, selection, at)
                )
            )
            selection += 1
            last = at
            moving = False
        down = pointer.down
    await nkl.sleep(900.0)
    return clicks

@nkl.function
async def similarity_arena() -> ArenaArrangement:
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            Layer(
                graphics=[
                    words(
                        "Drag every patch into the circle. Put patches that look alike close together,\n"
                        "and ones that look different far apart. Click Done when all are inside.",
                        0.0,
                        40.0,
                        18.0,
                        LIGHT,
                    ),
                    words(
                        "Press the space bar to begin",
                        0.0,
                        -40.0,
                        15.0,
                        QUIET,
                    ),
                ]
            )
        )
    )
    await nkl.next(nkl.filter(space, nkl.keys.stream()))
    start = Board(
        positions=START,
        order=[index for index in range(COUNT)],
        held=-1,
        grab=Location(x=0.0, y=0.0),
        was_down=False,
        hovered=-1,
        done=False,
    )
    board = nkl.scan(step, nkl.pointer.stream(), start)
    # The show and the wait for Done start in the same tick, so they follow the same board.
    await nkl.show(nkl.map(scene, board))
    began = await nkl.time()
    final = await nkl.next(
        nkl.filter(finished, nkl.changes(board))
    )
    ended = await nkl.time()
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(faded(final)))
    await nkl.sleep(360.0)
    positions = [
        Location(x=at.x / ARENA, y=at.y / ARENA)
        for at in final.positions
    ]
    return ArenaArrangement(
        stimuli=[
            Stimulus(
                orientation=ORIENTATION[i],
                frequency=FREQUENCY[i],
            )
            for i in range(COUNT)
        ],
        positions=positions,
        distances=[
            [distance(a, b) for b in final.positions]
            for a in final.positions
        ],
        arena_radius=ARENA,
        milliseconds=ended - began,
    )

@nkl.function
async def attempt(number: int) -> CartAttempt:
    """Attempt `number`, from a nearly upright pole, until it fails or 30 s pass."""
    s = CartPoleState(
        x=0.0, speed=0.0, angle=TILTS[number], spin=0.0
    )
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            still(
                s,
                piecewise(
                    [(0.0, 0.0), (300.0, 1.0)],
                    between="smoothstep",
                ),
            )
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(900.0)
    start = await nkl.time()
    now = start
    trail: list[Location] = []
    states: list[CartPoleLog] = []
    ended_by = "time"
    k = 0
    while True:
        push = pushed(await nkl.read(nkl.keys.signal()))
        following = step(s, push)
        trail = trail[-TRAIL:] + [tip(s)]
        await nkl.show(
            nkl.constant(scene(s, following, trail))
        )
        states = logged(states, k, now - start, s, push)
        # Each step is due on a 20 ms grid from the start, so a late wake does not stretch the attempt.
        k += 1
        due = start + STEP * k
        now = await nkl.sleep(max(due - now, 1.0))
        s = following
        if abs(s.angle) > FAIL_ANGLE:
            ended_by = "pole"
            break
        if abs(s.x) > RAIL:
            ended_by = "rail"
            break
        if now - start >= LIMIT:
            break
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            still(
                s,
                piecewise(
                    [
                        (0.0, 1.0),
                        (300.0, 1.0),
                        (900.0, 0.0),
                    ],
                    between="smoothstep",
                ),
            )
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(1100.0)
    return CartAttempt(
        milliseconds=now - start,
        ended_by=ended_by,
        states=states,
    )

@nkl.function
async def trial(number: int, tilt: float) -> TiltTrial:
    clockwise = CLOCKWISE[number]
    phase = PHASES[number]
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            presentation(tilt, clockwise, phase)
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(FIXATION)
    shown = await nkl.time()
    keys = await nkl.next(
        nkl.filter(answered, nkl.keys.stream())
    )
    pressed = await nkl.time()
    if pressed - shown < DURATION:
        # An answer during the patch lets it finish its ramp rather than cutting it off.
        await nkl.sleep(DURATION - (pressed - shown))
    answer = "right arrow" in keys.keys
    correct = answer == clockwise
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(feedback(correct)))
    await nkl.sleep(FEEDBACK)
    return TiltTrial(
        tilt=tilt,
        clockwise=clockwise,
        phase=phase,
        answered_clockwise=answer,
        correct=correct,
        milliseconds=pressed - shown,
    )

@nkl.function
async def trial(
    number: int, contrast: float
) -> ContrastTrial:
    interval = INTERVALS[number]
    phase = PHASES[number]
    seed = SEEDS[number]
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            presentation(
                contrast, interval, phase, seed
            )
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(DONE)
    ended = await nkl.time()
    keys = await nkl.next(
        nkl.filter(answered, nkl.keys.stream())
    )
    pressed = await nkl.time()
    answer = 1 if "1" in keys.keys else 2
    correct = answer == interval
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(feedback(correct)))
    await nkl.sleep(FEEDBACK)
    return ContrastTrial(
        contrast=contrast,
        interval=interval,
        answered=answer,
        correct=correct,
        milliseconds=pressed - ended,
    )

@nkl.function
async def trial(
    size: int, changed: bool, key: int
) -> ChangeTrial:
    cells = shuffled(CELLS, nkl.hash([key, 1]))
    hues = shuffled(len(COLOURS), nkl.hash([key, 2]))
    places = [place(cells[i], key) for i in range(size)]
    colours = [hues[i] for i in range(size)]
    probe = nkl.hash([key, 3]) % size
    # A changed probe takes a colour no square had, as in Luck and Vogel's displays.
    tested = hues[size] if changed else colours[probe]
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            sequence(places, colours, probe, tested)
        )
    )
    start = await nkl.time()
    await nkl.sleep(ONSET)
    keys = await nkl.next(
        nkl.filter(answered, nkl.keys.stream())
    )
    pressed = await nkl.time()
    different = DIFFERENT_KEY in keys.keys
    correct = different == changed
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            answer(places[probe], tested, correct)
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(FEEDBACK + PAUSE)
    return ChangeTrial(
        set_size=size,
        changed=changed,
        places=places,
        colours=colours,
        probe=probe,
        tested=tested,
        said_different=different,
        correct=correct,
        milliseconds=pressed - start - ONSET,
    )

@nkl.function
async def trial(k: int) -> TrackingTrial:
    await nkl.show(nkl.constant(MOTION[k]))
    await nkl.sleep(MARK + MOVE)
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(stopped(k, [], -1, False))
    )
    shown = await nkl.time()
    picks = await nkl.race(choose(k), show_cursor())
    picked = await nkl.time()
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(stopped(k, picks, -1, True))
    )
    await nkl.sleep(2000.0)
    await nkl.show(
        nkl.constant(
            Layer(
                graphics=[
                    arena(),
                    Opacity(
                        stopped(k, picks, -1, True),
                        piecewise(
                            [(0, 1.0), (300, 0.0)],
                            between="smoothstep",
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            )
        )
    )
    await nkl.sleep(500.0)
    hits = sum(1 for i in picks if i in CHOSEN[k])
    return TrackingTrial(
        targets=CHOSEN[k],
        picks=picks,
        hits=hits,
        milliseconds=picked - shown,
    )
